title: Sprint 5 - Real-Time Chat App (Slack Clone) 🆕
description: The ultimate capstone. A fully Real-Time WebSocket-driven chat application.

tickets.title: Message Feed UI
tickets.description: Build the core chat interface with a sticky message input.
tasks: Build the core chat interface with a sticky message input.
learning_objectives: Flexbox `flex-direction: column` layouts and scrolling containers.
tickets.evaluation: Visual Grader expects a bottom-aligned input area and the "General Chat" header. Logic Grader expects array mapping (`.map`) and specific CSS classes (`.chat-input-area`).
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: WebSocket Integration
tickets.description: Connect to a live WebSocket server to listen for new messages instantly without polling.
tasks: Connect to a live WebSocket server to listen for new messages instantly without polling.
learning_objectives: Initializing WebSockets, cleaning up connections on unmount, and managing external subscriptions in React.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader explicitly checks for `useEffect` and `WebSocket` initialization.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: Auto-Scroll to Bottom

tasks: Automatically scroll the chat window down when a new message arrives.
learning_objectives: Using the `useRef` hook to directly access and manipulate DOM nodes.

tickets.title: Infinite Scroll Pagination
tickets.description: When the user scrolls to the top of the chat, automatically fetch the next page of older messages.

learning_objectives: The `IntersectionObserver` API and scroll position retention.
